thread.title: Dow Movers: VZ, V

author: BNK Invest
title: Dow Movers: VZ, V
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Friday, shares of Visa ( V ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 4.5%. Year to date, Visa registers a 22.5% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is Verizon Communications ( VZ ), trading down 0.5%. Verizon Communications is showing a gain of 0.3% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ), trading down 0.1%, and Apple ( AAPL ), trading up 2.7% on the day.
